query: SELECT t.TABLE_NAME, IF(c.COLUMN_NAME IS NOT NULL, 'HAS', 'NO') as has_companyId FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES t LEFT JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c ON t.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME AND c.COLUMN_NAME = 'companyId' AND c.TABLE_SCHEMA = t.TABLE_SCHEMA WHERE t.TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND t.TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' ORDER BY has_companyId DESC, t.TABLE_NAME
